	hidden_trigger = { tag = ARG exists = yes is_dynamic_country = no IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes }

COLDWAR_ARG_authoritarian_government = {
	OR = {
		western_autocrats_are_in_power = yes
		emerging_reactionaries_are_in_power = yes
		nationalist_military_junta_are_in_power = yes
		has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ARG_corporate_constitution
		AND = { emerging_communist_state_are_in_power = yes has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_ARG_pca_vanguard }
		AND = { neutrality_neutral_communism_are_in_power = yes has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_ARG_prt_revolution }
		AND = { emerging_anarchist_communism_are_in_power = yes has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_ARG_mont_command }
	}
}

		COLDWAR_ARG_is_scenario = yes
		NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ARG_targeted_safety_applied }
		check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
		OR = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_ARG_contract_courts }
		NOT = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_ARG_strict_subsidies }
	}
	neutrality_neutral_libertarians_are_in_power = yes
}

		}
	}
	owns_state = 450
	controls_state = 450
	COLDWAR_ARG_can_build_450_uranium_mine_1 = yes
